series.label: See
series.summary: Visibility: what you have, what is happening on it, and what you are blind to, with free and freemium tools and a lab you can run.

guides.title: You cannot defend what you cannot see
guides.question: Which signals exist, what each one answers, and where the blind spots usually are

guides.title: Inventory: what is actually there
guides.question: What runs, who owns it, what talks to it

guides.title: What the internet sees of you
guides.question: Which names, addresses, certificates and services an outsider can find

guides.title: The log pipeline: one place to look
guides.question: How every signal gets collected, parsed, stamped with the right time and kept

guides.title: The SIEM: security events in one place
guides.question: Which security events arrive, in one schema, kept for how long, and searchable by whom

guides.title: Servers: health and host activity
guides.question: Is it up, is it busy, what changed on it

guides.title: Firewall traffic
guides.question: What was allowed and denied, and by which rule

guides.title: Network: flows, packets and DNS
guides.question: Who talks to whom, how much, and which names they look up

guides.title: The web proxy and the way out
guides.question: Which users and machines reach which sites and services

guides.title: Load balancers and the edge
guides.question: What customers actually experience: errors, latency, TLS, backend health

guides.title: Databases, and where personal data lives
guides.question: Who queried what, who changed permissions, which tables hold personal data

guides.title: Applications and APIs
guides.question: Where a request spent its time and where it failed

guides.title: Identity
guides.question: Who signed in, from where, with what, and what they were given

guides.title: SaaS and email
guides.question: What happens in the SaaS applications, and who sends mail as you

guides.title: Endpoints
guides.question: What ran on a laptop, till or server, and what it connected to

guides.title: Containers and cloud
guides.question: What runs in containers, what images hold, what changed outside the pipeline

guides.title: Warehouse automation
guides.question: What the sorter, scanners and printers are doing, and who talks to them

guides.title: Assurance: proving you can see
guides.question: Is every asset sending every signal, did the backups work, would an attack show up

guides.title: Watching AI itself
guides.question: Who calls which AI service, with what data and key, what agents did, and what it cost

guides.title: Deception: tripwires only an intruder touches
guides.question: Who touched something no legitimate person or system ever should
